plainText:
Anjali Kunapaneni is an Indian-American voice actor for the English-language dub of and .

==Biography==
Kunapaneni was born on December 13, 2000 in , USA. They became a voice actor as an adult. They joined during , where they voiced Project Mew member Danika. They gained a more notable role in , voicing Roy.

Kunapaneni is and uses they/them pronouns.
